[[File:Anagram reference - Angel Eyes in The Good, the Bad and the Ugly.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Angel Eyes (Lee Van Cleef), 1966.]]
'''Angel Eyes''' is the mercenary played by Lee Van Cleef in Sergio Leone's 1966 western ''The Good, the Bad and the Ugly'', where he is "the Bad". He hunts the same buried Confederate gold as [[Blondie (The Good, the Bad and the Ugly)|Blondie]] (Clint Eastwood), "the Good", and Tuco (Eli Wallach), "the Ugly", and dies in the three-way standoff at the end of the film.<ref name="wp-gbu">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Good,_the_Bad_and_the_Ugly The Good, the Bad and the Ugly], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027184439/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Good,_the_Bad_and_the_Ugly Internet Archive], 27 October 2026.</ref>

== Star Wars CCG ==
[[File:SE-D-gelayeens.gif|thumb|left|200px|[[Gela Yeens]] ([[Special Edition]])|link=Gela Yeens]]
The [[Special Edition]] card [[Gela Yeens]] is an anagram of Angel Eyes. The anagram list marks it "(BAD)" and gives the film as the relation.<ref name="geo">[https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians], oocities.org (GeoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008200413/https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 200. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.</ref> Its lore reads:
<blockquote>Bad-tempered smuggler. Makes a few credits more helping Jabba collect debts. Highly regarded for his uncanny anticipation in battle. Searching for Debnoli.</blockquote>
[[Debnoli]], the card it is searching for, is an anagram of Blondie.<ref name="geo">[https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians], oocities.org (GeoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008200413/https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.</ref>
